About recovery

Requires the supported Global Themes version, Android user 0 and ADB Shizuku/Shevery. Preparation verifies the older APK and automatically saves the Studio ZIP and the original APK set to Downloads/MTZ Studio/Backups. When accessible, one aggregate themes.bak contains the readable external themes. Preparation does not remove Themes.

themes.bak contains partial external data only, not Themes private data, accounts or settings. Restoring it after uninstall or across versions is not guaranteed. Installation can fail after removal; re-enabling Themes does not restore deleted data or guarantee the factory version.
